fragment_catalog_audit.endpoint_proposal_rule: Evenly rank-spaced safeends within1024codepoints, includeearliest/latest, farthestfirst; onlynearestbeyondhorizon ifnoneinside.

latency_scope: Context preparation includes packing and real pair tokenizations; common catalog/BGE/index/init/cleanup excluded and reported separately. Native query includes returned-hit validation. Inclusive outer clock is authoritative whole-batch bound.
